chain.label: Known thunderstorm activity near SLC
chain.trigger: a go-around near known thunderstorm activity; a convective SIGMET ... valid for the accident site

chain.label: Crosswind from the left during initial landing attempt
chain.trigger: unable to maintain directional control of the airplane due to wind from the left

caused_by.evidence: Rain showers and convective clouds can produce downdrafts, outflow boundaries, and gust fronts ... favorable for unexpected changes in surface wind direction and speed

chain.label: FAA denied SLC's request for additional wind sensors
chain.trigger: the request was denied in April 2016 for budgetary reasons

chain.label: ATC wind report relied on single center-field sensor, unaware of much stronger ASOS winds
chain.trigger: ATC and the wind shear detection system did not have access to the ASOS wind information, and the pilot was not aware of it

caused_by.evidence: an inadequate amount of wind sensors and wind shear detection equipment used by the air traffic control (ATC) tower to detect microburst activity at the airport

chain.label: Airplane climbing through only about 30 ft AGL during the go-around
chain.trigger: After adding power and climbing to about 30 ft above ground level, he 'lowered the left wing' to counteract the drift

caused_by.evidence: he decided to go around because he was unable to maintain directional control of the airplane due to wind from the left

chain.label: Pilot encountered a microburst during the go-around climb
chain.trigger: Subsequently, he encountered a microburst that caused the airplane to descend

caused_by.evidence: a go-around near known thunderstorm activity
climbing to about 30 ft above ground level
the pilot was not aware of [the ASOS wind information]

chain.label: Pilot unable to maintain control of the airplane in the microburst
chain.trigger: the pilot's inability to maintain control of the airplane when it encountered a microburst

caused_by.evidence: a microburst that caused the airplane to descend before impacting terrain

chain.label: Airplane impacted terrain off the runway in a left-wing-low attitude
chain.trigger: impacted terrain, off the right side of the runway, in a left-wing-low attitude

chain.label: Pilot sustained minor injuries; airplane substantially damaged
chain.trigger: The pilot sustained minor injuries, and the airplane sustained substantial damage to the wings and fuselage
